standard_prerequisites.name: The free group as a higher inductive type
standard_prerequisites.statement: F(A) is generated by eta : A -> F(A), a multiplication, an identity, an inverse and the group axioms as path constructors, together with a 0-truncation constructor.
standard_prerequisites.use: Its recursion principle is the entire forward direction of the proof at source line 1621, and its computation rules give the homomorphism property at line 1622.

standard_prerequisites.name: Recursion and induction principles of a 0-truncated higher inductive type
standard_prerequisites.statement: A map F(A) -> G into a set G is determined by its values on the constructors, and an equality between two such maps is determined on the generators.
standard_prerequisites.use: The right inverse is obtained by recursion at line 1621 and the left inverse by induction at line 1624.

standard_prerequisites.name: Group homomorphisms
standard_prerequisites.statement: hom_Group(F(A), G) is the set of group homomorphisms from F(A) to G.
standard_prerequisites.use: The statement is phrased with that set, and the proof must show that the map obtained from f is a homomorphism, which it gets from the computation rules at line 1622.

core_obligations: Read the recursion principle of the higher inductive type F(A) as saying that a group G together with a function f : A -> G yields fbar : F(A) -> G (source line 1621).
Use the computation rules to get fbar o eta := f as well as the statement that fbar is a group homomorphism, which together exhibit the right inverse of composition with eta (source line 1622).
Conclude that (blank o eta) : hom_Group(F(A),G) -> (A -> G) has a right inverse (source line 1623).
Apply the induction principle of F(A) to show that the same map is also a left inverse, using that the goal is a set (source line 1624).

proof_roadmap.step: Obtain the extension fbar from the recursion principle and read off its computation rules, including that it is a homomorphism.
Right inverse from the computation rule on eta, left inverse by induction on the generators.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled theorem at source lines 1611-1619, Theorem 6.11.6: F(A) is the free group on A, i.e. composition with eta is an equivalence from hom_Group(F(A),G) to A -> G for every group G. The statement is a universal property of a higher inductive type that is itself 0-truncated, and the proof (source lines 1620-1625) is short but not routine: the forward direction is exactly the recursion principle, whose data must include the multiplication, identity, inverse and the group axioms of the codomain (line 1621), and the computation rules are what simultaneously give fbar o eta := f and the statement that fbar is a homomorphism (line 1622). The left-inverse direction at line 1624 is again an induction over the same constructors rather than a computation.
